subject: Room booking before print deadline
text:
Can you confirm whether the room booking has been changed to the smaller hall before I post the updated notice? The landlord called this morning and said the main gallery is now reserved for an event after noon, so our usual table layout may not fit if we wait. I do not want to tell members one thing and correct it later. Since you are now the new client contact and still know how we handled contracts last year, you are the best person to verify what the new clause actually allows. The question is narrow: can we keep the original start time without paying an extra fee, or must we move everything earlier?

The change is time-sensitive because the printing run closes at four. If you know the answer now, tell me which wording I should use and I will place the notice. If you need to check the agreement first, say so quickly, because the last thing I want is a rushed correction after the flyers have gone out.

I have not altered the calendar entry or the reminder text yet. I also left the speaker's name out of the draft until I know whether the afternoon slot remains usable. If the hall change creates a seating issue, the simplest option is to reduce the guest list by the number of chairs that cannot be placed, but I would prefer not to decide that without hearing from you.
